This includes focusing on **waste prevention** and **eco-innovation**, which can lead to more sustainable production processes. The circular economy emphasizes treating waste as a resource, thereby minimizing environmental impact and promoting sustainable practices [3]. Furthermore, adopting a **life-cycle thinking** approach at the policy level can help explore inter-linkages that enable better resource utilization [3]. By fostering collaboration between sectors and implementing effective waste management laws, industries can significantly improve their resource efficiency [3].
